feed.title: Artificial Intelligence Benefits Database: feed of new and revised cases

entry.title: A demand-routing app helps less skilled taxi drivers find fares
entry.summary: In Yokohama in December 2019, the AI Navi app cut taxi drivers' cruising time by 5% on average and 7% for low-skilled drivers, narrowing the skill gap by 13.4%.

entry.title: A GPT-4 tool helps lone P&G staff match human teams
entry.summary: In a field experiment with 776 P&G professionals, individuals using a GPT-4-based tool raised solution quality by 0.37 SD and spent 16.4% less time, matching teams without AI.

entry.title: Machine translation lifts cross-border sales on eBay
entry.summary: eBay's in-house machine translation, introduced for Latin America in May 2014, raised exports on eBay by 10.9% in the published study and 17.5% to 20.9% in the working paper.

entry.title: ChatGPT saves science teachers planning time each week
entry.summary: In an NFER trial in 68 schools, teachers using ChatGPT with a guide spent 56.2 minutes a week on Year 7 and 8 science lesson preparation against 81.5 minutes for teachers without it.

entry.title: Two legal AI tools improve students' legal work in a trial
entry.summary: In a randomized trial with 137 law students, Vincent AI and o1-preview raised the quality of legal work and raised productivity on five of six tasks by 50% to 130%.

entry.title: GPT-4 speeds up legal drafting for law students
entry.summary: In a randomized trial with 60 Minnesota law students, GPT-4 cut time on four legal tasks by 11.8% to 32.1%, with slight and uneven gains in quality.

entry.title: ChatGPT speeds up everyday professional writing
entry.summary: In a preregistered experiment with 453 college-educated professionals, ChatGPT cut time on writing tasks by 40% and raised graded quality by 18%.

entry.title: Consultants with GPT-4 finish more tasks in less time
entry.summary: In a preregistered experiment with 758 BCG consultants, GPT-4 users completed 12.2% more tasks 25.1% faster with higher quality, but erred more on a task beyond its reach.

entry.title: A chat assistant helps new support agents resolve more issues
entry.summary: A GPT-based chat assistant raised issues resolved per hour by 15% on average among 5,172 support agents, with the largest gains for novice and low-skilled agents.

entry.title: Camera-trap software helps an island program hunt feral cats
entry.summary: On Kangaroo Island, eVorta AI found 97.9% of 492 feral cat images against 95.3% for staff; with 4G cameras, the board estimates A$2.15 million saved over three years.

entry.title: A sound recognizer nearly matches bird experts on a Munich rooftop
entry.summary: TU Munich researchers compared BirdNET with two experts on 15.5 hours of rooftop recordings; with tuned settings BirdNET reached an F1 score of 0.84 and found one species the experts missed.

entry.title: A computer screen finds antibody fragments for an itch receptor
entry.summary: Harvard and UCSF researchers co-folded 10,000 nanobodies with MRGPRX2 in AlphaFold-Multimer; of ten tested, three bound at 20 to 200 nM and blocked mast cell degranulation.

entry.title: A predicted model unlocks a stubborn crystal structure
entry.summary: After two years of failed phasing, a CNRS team in Palaiseau solved the structure of a protein from the mRNA decay pathway by molecular replacement with AlphaFold and RoseTTAFold models.

entry.title: A predicted receptor shape speeds the search for psychiatric drug leads
entry.summary: Uppsala and Karolinska researchers docked compounds against AlphaFold models of TAAR1; 18 of 30 tested were agonists (60%), against 22% from a homology model.

entry.title: Predicted protein shapes guide a search for new drug leads
entry.summary: UCSF-led teams docked up to 1.6 billion molecules against AlphaFold2 models of the sigma-2 and 5-HT2A receptors; hit rates (54% and 26%) matched those from experimental structures.

entry.title: Europe's forecast center tests Pangu-Weather beside its own model
entry.summary: ECMWF ran Huawei's Pangu-Weather from its own analyses and found accuracy comparable to its IFS model, with better summer temperature-event forecasts in Europe.

entry.title: NICE lets NHS talking therapies use the Limbic Access chatbot
entry.summary: NICE cites a study in which NHS services using the Limbic Access referral chatbot saw referrals rise 15% against 6% in control services, with larger rises in minority groups.

entry.title: NICE backs AI help for spotting fractures on X-rays
entry.summary: NICE reviewed 16 studies of AI fracture software such as BoneView and found that readers' sensitivity rose without lost specificity, from 61% to 74% in one study.

entry.title: NICE finds AI outlining quicker for radiotherapy planning
entry.summary: NICE reviewed 79 studies and concluded that AI autocontouring with clinician review, by systems such as MVision and Limbus Contour, is likely equivalent to manual contouring and quicker.

entry.title: England's health technology assessor backs AI help in colonoscopy
entry.summary: NICE reviewed 70 studies, most of them randomized trials, and concluded that AI polyp detection systems such as GI Genius improve the adenoma detection rate in colonoscopy.

entry.title: Europe's medicines regulator accepts AIM-NASH for biopsy scoring
entry.summary: EMA qualified PathAI's AIM-NASH after a 1,481-case validation in which AI-assisted pathologists agreed better with expert panels on inflammation and ballooning.

entry.title: Medicare's payment review credits ContaCT with faster stroke alerts
entry.summary: CMS found that Viz.ai ContaCT shortens time to specialist notification for large vessel occlusion stroke; in routine use the median time to notification was 4.31 minutes.

entry.title: Auditors review the Justice Transcribe note tool in probation
entry.summary: The NAO reports that Justice Transcribe, an AI note tool, summarized over 1,600,000 probation meetings in England and Wales, an estimated 266,667 hours saved.

entry.title: Model Dermatology helps trainees diagnose skin lesions in Seoul
entry.summary: In a Seoul trial of 576 patients with suspicious skin lesions, non-expert physicians using Model Dermatology diagnosed 53.9% correctly against 43.8% without it.

entry.title: Cybersight AI results on the day lift eye referrals in Kigali
entry.summary: In the RAIDERS trial at four Kigali diabetes clinics, immediate Cybersight AI feedback raised 30-day referral attendance to 51.5% from 39.6% with delayed human grading.

entry.title: SELENA+ results on the spot bring more Tanzanians to eye care
entry.summary: In a Tanzanian trial of 2,378 people with diabetes, SELENA+ results and counselling at screening raised clinic attendance for referable retinopathy from 18.2% to 35.9%.

entry.title: ENAD-DET-01 helps Seoul endoscopists find more adenomas
entry.summary: In a two-hospital Seoul trial of 998 patients, colonoscopy with Ainex's ENAD-DET-01 found adenomas in 52.3% of patients against 36.1% with standard colonoscopy.

entry.title: GI Genius lifts adenoma detection in VA colonoscopy units
entry.summary: At 42 VA facilities chosen at random to receive GI Genius, adenoma detection rose from 50.7% to 54.9%, while it fell from 51.8% to 51.1% at 97 control facilities.

entry.title: Vara MG helps German screening radiologists find more breast cancers
entry.summary: Across 463,094 women at 12 German screening sites, radiologists who used Vara MG found 6.7 cancers per 1,000 against 5.7 without it, with no rise in recalls.

entry.title: Insight MMG as a third reader finds more breast cancers in Stockholm
entry.summary: At Capio Sankt Göran Hospital, Lunit's Insight MMG read 55,581 mammograms beside two radiologists; the three together found 269 cancers against 250 by the radiologists alone.

entry.title: Transpara helps Swedish breast screening find more cancers
entry.summary: In the MASAI trial of 105,934 women, Transpara-supported screening found 6.4 cancers per 1,000 against 5.0 with standard double reading and cut screen reading by 44.2%.

entry.title: A phone camera coach improved fitness and blood pressure in hypertension
entry.summary: In a 62-person Guangzhou trial, 8 weeks of AI pose-guided home exercise added 62.77 m to 6-minute walk distance and lowered systolic pressure more than usual care.

entry.title: An automated diabetes prevention app did as well as human coaches
entry.summary: In a 368-person Johns Hopkins trial, the *Sweetch* AI-led diabetes prevention program met the risk-reduction goal as often as human coaching (31.7% vs 31.9%).

entry.title: A mental health chatbot eased anxiety and low mood in tinnitus
entry.summary: In a Leeds Trinity University trial of 105 adults with tinnitus, 8 weeks of *Woebot* cut anxiety and depression scores against a waitlist; *Tinnibot* did more.

entry.title: BoneView helps Poitiers emergency doctors read fracture X-rays
entry.summary: At Poitiers University Hospital's emergency department, the X-ray discrepancy rate fell by 17% and mean stay by 9 minutes after Gleamer BoneView arrived (3,720 patients).

entry.title: Automated scan alerts help Houston stroke teams start treatment sooner
entry.summary: At four Houston comprehensive stroke centers, Viz.ai LVO detection with mobile alerts cut door-to-groin time for thrombectomy by 11.2 minutes.

entry.title: An early warning helps Amsterdam anesthetists keep blood pressure up
entry.summary: In the HYPE trial at Amsterdam UMC, the Hypotension Prediction Index cut median time in hypotension during surgery from 32.7 to 8.0 minutes per patient.

entry.title: Return Review Program catches refund fraud that older filters missed
entry.summary: TIGTA found that IRS Return Review Program identity-theft models alone selected $1.88 billion, or 47.8%, of $3.92 billion in confirmed identity-theft refunds in 2015.

entry.title: Computer-read chest X-rays speed TB treatment at a Malawi clinic
entry.summary: In the PROSPECT trial at a Blantyre clinic, TB patients offered HIV testing plus chest X-rays read by CAD4TB started treatment a median of 1 day after the visit, against 11 days under standard care.

entry.title: ArteraAI Prostate sorted prostate cancer patients by risk of spread
entry.summary: In FDA's review of ArteraAI Prostate, among 886 patients, 10-year metastasis risk was 28.1% in its high risk category and 3.3% in its low category, against 8.1% overall.

entry.title: Allix5 read five-year breast cancer risk from a mammogram
entry.summary: In FDA's review of Clairity Allix5, the software predicted five-year breast cancer risk from 77,511 screening mammograms with an AUC of 0.70, above a goal of 0.64.

entry.title: Viz HCM picked out a hard-to-diagnose heart disease from ECGs
entry.summary: In FDA's review of Viz HCM, the software flagged hypertrophic cardiomyopathy on 12-lead ECGs from three hospitals with 68.4% sensitivity and 99.1% specificity.

entry.title: DermaSensor raised primary care sensitivity for skin cancer
entry.summary: In FDA's review of DermaSensor, primary care physicians aided by the device referred skin cancers with 91.4% sensitivity, against 82.0% unaided; standalone sensitivity was 95.5%.

entry.title: Cognoa ASD Diagnosis Aid matched specialists when it gave a result
entry.summary: In the 14-site study that FDA reviewed, the Cognoa ASD Diagnosis Aid gave a result for 32% of 425 children, with 81% PPV and 98% sensitivity against specialist diagnosis.

entry.title: QuantX gave radiologists a small lift on breast MRI
entry.summary: In the reader study that FDA reviewed for QuantX, 19 radiologists reading 111 breast MRI cases raised their AUC from 0.7055 to 0.7575 with the software.

entry.title: OsteoDetect helped clinicians spot wrist fractures on X-rays
entry.summary: In the reader study that FDA reviewed for OsteoDetect, 24 clinicians found distal radius fractures with 80.3% sensitivity when aided, against 74.7% unaided.

entry.title: Sepsis ImmunoScore sorted patients by sepsis risk in FDA's review
entry.summary: In FDA's review of the Prenosis Sepsis ImmunoScore, sepsis within 24 hours rose from 3.02% in its low risk category to 69.70% in its very high category; AUROC was 0.81.

entry.title: Caption Guidance let nurses take usable heart scans
entry.summary: In FDA's review of Caption Guidance, eight nurses new to echocardiography scanned 240 patients with AI guidance; cardiologists judged left ventricular size assessable in 98.8% of exams.

entry.title: Paige Prostate helped pathologists catch cancer missed on a first read
entry.summary: In the reader study that FDA reviewed for Paige Prostate, assisted reads improved sensitivity in 7.3% of prostate biopsy images with cancer, and specificity rose 1.1 points.

entry.title: GI Genius helped endoscopists find more adenomas in a randomized trial
entry.summary: In the randomized Italian trial that FDA reviewed, colonoscopy with GI Genius found adenomas in 55.1% of low-risk patients, against 42.0% with standard colonoscopy.

entry.title: ContaCT alerts came sooner than usual care in a test on past scans
entry.summary: In a retrospective test that FDA reviewed, Viz.ai ContaCT sent its stroke alert in 7.32 minutes on average, against 58.72 minutes for usual-care notification of the specialist.

entry.title: An autonomous eye exam passed its trial in primary care clinics
entry.summary: In the trial that FDA reviewed for the IDx-DR De Novo grant, the AI found more than mild diabetic retinopathy with 87.4% sensitivity and 89.5% specificity in primary care.

entry.title: ChatGPT guidance improves dental students' simulated skill scores
entry.summary: In a 2024 randomized trial with 187 dental undergraduates in China, students who used ChatGPT-3.5 with instructional videos scored 73.12 against 65.54 on a virtual reality skills test.

entry.title: ChatGPT-4 study plans lift Pakistani medical students' surgery scores
entry.summary: At Islamic International Medical College, Pakistan, 100 students were randomized in 2024; after two hours of study, the ChatGPT-4 group scored 22.8 against 19.24 on an acute abdomen test.

entry.title: ChatGPT hints help adults learn algebra and statistics online
entry.summary: In a UC Berkeley experiment with 274 Mechanical Turk workers in 2023, ChatGPT-written math hints gave a 17% pre-to-post gain, the only gain significant against a no-hint control.

entry.title: TA Pounce chatbot helps Georgia State students earn higher grades
entry.summary: In trials with 2,483 Georgia State students in online Government and Microeconomics courses from 2021 to 2023, the TA Pounce text chatbot raised the share earning an A or B by 4 points.

entry.title: ChatGPT shortens science teachers' lesson preparation
entry.summary: In a 2024 trial with 259 science teachers in 68 schools, teachers told to use ChatGPT spent 56.2 minutes a week on lesson preparation against 81.5, with no evidence of lower quality.

entry.title: Mindspark lab periods raise math and Hindi scores in Rajasthan
entry.summary: In an 80-school trial in Rajasthan, India, students in the 40 schools that used Mindspark in school hours scored 0.22 SD higher in math and 0.20 SD higher in Hindi after 18 months.

entry.title: Letrus essay feedback lifts Brazilian students' exam essay scores
entry.summary: In a 2019 trial in 178 public high schools in Espírito Santo, Brazil, Letrus automated essay scoring and feedback raised ENEM essay scores by 0.094 standard deviations.

entry.title: Transpara cut mammogram reading work in a Swedish randomized trial
entry.summary: In the MASAI trial of 105,934 women in Sweden, Transpara-guided triage cut screen readings by 44.2% and raised cancer detection from 5.0 to 6.4 per 1,000.
